page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs, consisting of 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, and 188.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.88 GB of RAM per core. The instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU containing 24 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying instead on network-attached storage options, and delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates strong capabilities in machine learning workloads, particularly in LLM inference. For a small 135M model, it achieves prompt processing speeds of 9700.0 tokens per second and text generation speeds of 454.43 tokens per second, both placing in the top tier. For a medium 7B model, prompt processing reaches 2489.49 tokens per second and text generation reaches 90.21 tokens per second, also in the top tier. General CPU performance is solid, with a PassMark CPU score of 36547.02 and a Geekbench multi-core score of 13808.0. Memory read bandwidth for large uncached blocks is measured at 126.91 GB/sec, while write bandwidth is 53.4 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn7i-c32g1.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density for GPU-accelerated tasks, combining dedicated Intel Xeon compute cores with a mid-range enterprise GPU. The absence of local storage means users only pay for the compute and GPU resources, though network storage costs must be factored in separately. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for medium-scale deep learning inference, AI model serving, video transcoding, and graphics-intensive rendering workloads, while also supporting general-purpose compute tasks that require moderate memory capacity.
